features.statement: Page title is just the organization name, with no tagline appended
Hero headlines are stacked visibly at once, alternating white verb lines with orange accent-colored lines
A single sans-serif family (Helvetica Neue with Arial fallback) is used throughout, with no web fonts loaded
Hero tagline is small, light-weight, uppercase text with wide letter-spacing
Hero uses a full-bleed dusk city photo under a dark navy overlay or gradient
Photo credit appears as a small dark caption box, detached from its image
A thin dark utility bar above the header holds secondary links, a language selector and text-only social links
Header is tall and white, with right-aligned navigation items marked by dropdown caret triangles
Primary buttons are navy with white text and modest 6px radius
Long page divided into full-width bands alternating white, pale grey-blue, orange and navy backgrounds
Palette combines dark navy, warm orange accent and teal secondary accent
Full-width orange announcement strip with small uppercase label, bold title and navy pill button
Content sections use two-column splits, with intro copy on one side and a cloud of pill-shaped chips on the other
Intro text uses a larger grey lead paragraph followed by smaller, darker body text
Promo band has a warm peach gradient background with a raised, rounded, softly shadowed logo card
Calls to action use generic labels like 'Click Here' alongside orange or navy pill buttons
News headlines are prefixed with the outlet name and a pipe separator, and may be in another language
News and events appear as three-column grids of thinly bordered, rounded white cards
Centered 'View all' buttons are navy outline pills placed below card grids
Forms use dark-filled inputs with placeholders instead of visible labels, plus full-width orange pill submit buttons
Small-print legal disclaimers sit under forms
Footer has white bold uppercase letter-spaced column headings above muted grey-blue links
Footer includes a divider and a newsletter row with heading left, email input and orange pill button right
Page is link-dense relative to text volume
Markup uses few, non-utility class names with little inline styling
Semantic landmarks plus section and article elements are used, with alt text present on images
Heading hierarchy skips levels, such as h3 before h2 and h5 without h4
Motion is limited to hover transitions, with no keyframe animations or transforms apart from an animated GIF logo
